description: Java source code for the TbSendSmsNode class, a rule engine node in Thingsboard that sends SMS messages via configured providers.

classes.name: TbSendSmsNode
classes.description: A rule engine node that sends SMS messages through external providers, extending TbAbstractExternalNode.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the node with configuration, creating SMS sender if not using system settings.

methods.name: onMsg
methods.description: Handles incoming messages, sending SMS asynchronously and managing success/failure callbacks.

methods.name: sendSms
methods.description: Constructs and sends SMS messages based on message data and configuration.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Cleans up resources, destroying the SMS sender if initialized.

methods.name: createSmsSender
methods.description: Creates an SmsSender instance using the factory and provider configuration.
